To check or recover a backup: lock the database, choose Open database and select the copy. Enable read-only mode before unlocking. Check your entries before replacing the original. A keyfile or hardware key is still required if configured.

Local check of reused passwords, passwords shorter than 12 characters or made of one repeated character. Excludes the recycle bin and templates. No breach check or guarantee of strength. Tap an entry to review it.
